method_outcomes.B22: All prior routes converge to one missing module: non-autonomous/random generalized Stokes-Hodge endpoint tent-space stability plus the critical incompressible bilinear map; another restricted lemma would not attack it.
method_outcomes.B27: Quantifier swap explains why constant-transport and coefficient-adapted moving-frame endpoint results are only restricted subclasses; the source needs a general coefficient-class theorem or a source-valid negative witness.
method_outcomes.B23: Assuming the -1/2 barrier is genuine did not produce a certified obstruction: Piola structure, critical first-Picard scaling, determinant-one shear geometry and parabolic-Dini oscillation defeat the obvious failure mechanisms.

source_status: A bounded fresh check on 2026-09-17 found no theorem or counterexample deciding Agresti-Veraar Problem 10 for the arbitrary source-valid nonzero smooth transport coefficient class at smoothness <= -1/2. Agresti arXiv:2607.15140 (2026-07-16) concerns high-probability global smoothness for suitably chosen transport noise from subcritical positive-smoothness data and does not close the endpoint. Negative search is not proof of novelty or exhaustive openness.
